title: Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning: Evaluating Criterion-Shift Adaptation in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.02575v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models can perform new tasks without parameter updates through in-context learning (ICL), whose core mechanism is utilizing the support set for task induction. In the standard ICL setting, once the task is induced, its decision criterion remains fixed. However, in real-world applications, many tasks exhibit a stable high-level intent, while their decision criteria shift according to specific requirements. Thus, we introduce a new setting, denoted as Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning (CC-ICL), where models must infer the latent criterion from context and adjust predictions accordingly under fixed task semantics. To evaluate this capability, we propose two complementary metrics, Criterion Invariance and Criterion Sensitivity, capturing the model's robustness and adaptability under criterion shifts. We further construct CC-Bench, a multi-domain benchmark that supports evaluation under the CC-ICL setting. By

translated_title: 准则条件下的上下文学习：评估视觉-语言模型中的准则偏移适应能力
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型可以通过上下文学习（ICL）在无需参数更新的情况下执行新任务，其核心机制是利用支持集进行任务归纳。在标准的ICL设置中，一旦任务被归纳出来，其决策准则便保持固定。然而，在现实应用中，许多任务表现出稳定的高层意图，而其决策准则会根据具体需求发生偏移。因此，我们提出了一种新的设置，称为准则条件上下文学习（CC-ICL），在该设置中，模型必须在固定的任务语义下从上下文中推断潜在准则并相应地调整预测。为评估这一能力，我们提出了两个互补的指标——准则不变性和准则敏感性，以刻画模型在准则偏移下的鲁棒性和适应性。我们进一步构建了CC-Bench，一个支持在CC-ICL设置下进行评估的多领域基准。
tldr: 该论文提出了准则条件上下文学习（CC-ICL）这一新设置，并设计了准则不变性与准则敏感性两个互补指标以及多领域基准CC-Bench，用于评估视觉-语言模型在任务语义固定而决策准则动态变化时的推断与适应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning (CC-ICL), a new setting that evaluates vision-language models' ability to infer latent criteria from context under fixed task semantics, accompanied by two complementary metrics (Criterion Invariance and Criterion Sensitivity) and a multi-domain benchmark, CC-Bench.
